title: Scuffle – my browser TCG built on the card game War, with AI card art (playable now)
author: Jumponturtles
selftext:
Solo dev here. Scuffle is the card game War, but every card has an ability: 190 cards across 10 factions, story mode, ranked, cups, drafts and trading, all free in the browser.

The card art is AI-generated for now. When the game can afford it, I want to hire artists, and I’m already inviting artists from the community to submit official card art.

🎮 Play: [https://www.scuffletcg.com](https://www.scuffletcg.com)  
📚 Wiki: [https://scuffletcg.fandom.com](https://scuffletcg.fandom.com)  
💬 Discord: [https://discord.gg/yU3zZdE4aJ](https://discord.gg/yU3zZdE4aJ)  
🚀 Kickstarter: [https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/scuffletcg/scuffle-the-card-game-of-war-with-attitude](https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/scuffletcg/scuffle-the-card-game-of-war-with-attitude)  
☕ Ko-fi: [https://ko-fi.com/jumpyturtles](https://ko-fi.com/jumpyturtles)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Jumponturtles please add a bit about how you used AI and what the development process looked like. A mention that AI was involved isn't enough. It needs dev details. Rule 4 exists so promotional posts contribute to the conversation about making games. We want to avoid the sub getting drowned in low effort promotion. If this isn't updated, it may be removed.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Please see the requirements for posts about commercial games promotion.

**Game Promotion Posts Allowed, with Requirements**

You must discuss your game within the context of how it was developed using AI. Share with the community and give something for the community to talk about in your development experience with AI. A fire and forget video/image with no text, chatGPT bullet list may be removed by mods. If your game is being sold, you MUST apply the "Commercial Self Promotion" flair.
